# hivelocity_vps (Resource)

Provisions a VPS instance. Instances are ordered through the compute endpoint with a VPS product ID (see `hivelocity_product` with `is_vps = true`) and then managed through the VPS endpoints: `product_id` changes scale the instance, `ssh_key_ids` and `iso_id` changes are applied in place, and `os_name`/`hostname`/`script`/`tags` changes go through a reload.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Pick a VPS plan that is in stock in Tampa.
data "hivelocity_product" "vps" {
  first = true

  filter {
    name   = "is_vps"
    values = ["true"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "data_center"
    values = ["TPA1"]
  }

  filter {
    name   = "stock"
    values = ["available", "limited"]
  }
}

resource "hivelocity_ssh_key" "admin" {
  name       = "admin"
  public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
}

resource "hivelocity_vps" "app" {
  product_id        = data.hivelocity_product.vps.product_id
  location_name     = data.hivelocity_product.vps.data_center
  os_name           = "Ubuntu 22.04"
  hostname          = "app.terraform.test"
  public_ssh_key_id = hivelocity_ssh_key.admin.ssh_key_id
  tags              = ["app"]
  script            = file("${path.module}/cloud_init.yaml")
}

output "app_ip" {
  value = hivelocity_vps.app.primary_ip
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `hostname` (String) Hostname of the instance.
- `location_name` (String) Facility code to deploy in, for example `TPA1`.
- `os_name` (String) Operating system to install (see `hivelocity_product_operating_systems`).
- `product_id` (Number) ID of the VPS product. Changing it scales the instance to the new product.

### Optional

- `force_device_id` (Number) Force deployment of this device ID (internal use only).
- `iso_id` (String) ID of a `hivelocity_vps_iso` to attach to the instance. Unset to detach.
- `period` (String) Billing period: hourly|monthly|quarterly|semi-annually|annually|biennial|triennial.
- `public_ssh_key_id` (Number) ID of the SSH key to inject at provisioning time.
- `script` (String) Cloud-init or post-install script.
- `ssh_key_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the SSH keys authorized on the instance. Applied in place after provisioning.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags to apply to the instance.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `cloud_init` (String) Cloud-init script in effect.
- `device_id` (Number) Device ID of the instance.
- `facility_code` (String) Facility of the instance.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `memory` (Number) Memory in MB.
- `nics` (List of Object) Network interfaces of the instance. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nics))
- `order_id` (Number) Order the instance was created from.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Root password as reported by the API.
- `power_status` (String) Power status (ON|OFF).
- `primary_ip` (String) Primary public IP.
- `product_name` (String) Product name.
- `service_id` (Number) Service ID of the instance.
- `status` (String) Instance status, for example `Running`.
- `template_id` (String) Template used for the install.
- `vcpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the device ID
terraform import hivelocity_vps.app 12345
```
